purpose: Does a LIRF network built like v51 / v52's non-LIRF members beat the shipped LIRF network on LIRF's ordinary rows, above all where LIRF has no ADS-B (July 2026)? The masking that made v52's masked member was only ever used on non-LIRF rows: the member route skips LIRF (src/prc2026_final/members.py), and LIRF's unmatched rows are predicted by v29's round-1 LIRF context network (ens_ctx_lirf, 16 epochs, docs/adsb_ctx_lirf). Design reading: October (the fit partition's held-out month) and the transfer readings of the same design-fold models on July 2025 natural and thinned to July 2026's coverage (coverage-regime attempt a13: LIRF dark) and December 2025, exactly as the positional batch read its design models (tools/ctx3_pos_predict.py). No official score, ranking row or published aggregate is read.
rationale: LIRF holds about 40% of the projected ranking error (docs/error_map); in July 2026 every LIRF row is unmatched (0.2% matched against 93.9% in July 2025; docs/coverage_regime). On thinned July 2025 v29's LIRF network gained 0.85% on LIRF unmatched rows against 0.3% natural, and v29 transferred at twice its development gain. Since then the non-LIRF networks moved to 32 epochs (v30), a combination member (v51) and a masked member routed to unmatched rows (v52, -1.05% on October's unmatched rows in the combination batch). None of that reached LIRF.
hardware: Azure arcw0-arcw3 (Standard_D16ds_v7), CPU, tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --device cpu --threads 8, two lanes per worker (one lref32 and one lm25_32 seed per worker). CPU because the user's compute rule puts context-network rounds on CPU unless turnaround matters; arcw4-7 are finishing configs/tree_mask_design_v1.json's CatBoost seeds.

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --fold design, unchanged: the seasonal fold's fit partition (2025-02..06, 08, 09) with LIRF's non-population rows included in fitting and monitoring (the fill population = LIRF, no NM clock, no aircraft type, excluded as for ctx_lirf and nnl), October monitored, October predictions only.
protocol.transfer: tools/ctx3_lirf_predict.py (tools/ctx3_pos_predict.py with this declaration's runs): every saved model predicts October (scorer check against stop_predictions, RMS at most 0.05 s), July 2025 natural and a13-thinned, December 2025 natural and a13-thinned, on the workstation CPU. No label is read by the predictor.
protocol.never_read: No run trains on or monitors 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or the ranking months. July and December enter only as the transfer readings below, as in configs/adsb_ctx3_pos_v1.json.

variants.lref32: ref32 (the combination batch's 32-epoch reference) with LIRF non-population rows in fitting
variants.lm25_32: the same with masking p = 0.25 (v52's masked member's setting)

items.refresh: X = lref32's four-seed mean on every LIRF non-population row
items.refresh_mask: X = lref32's mean on matched rows and lm25_32's mean on unmatched rows (the route of v52's member)

protocol.baseline: B = the shipped LIRF network family ctx_lirf: October = the four round-B design seeds (runs/adsb_ctx/lirf_design/ctx_lirf_s1..s4/design/stop_predictions.parquet, the same fit partition); July natural / thinned = ens_ctx_lirf, the 16 development seeds 301-316 of the seasonal fold (the same fit partition) as re-predicted by the v29 coverage check (runs/adsb_ctx/regime_check_lirf/2025-07.parquet, hash-bound in docs/adsb_ctx_lirf/regime_check_2025-07.json). A 16-seed baseline against 4 new seeds is deliberately conservative.
protocol.rows: LIRF non-population rows (the rows ctx_lirf predicts in the stack); matched / unmatched by adsb_matched of the reading's own ADS-B table (natural or thinned). Every label kept, no clipping.

readings.L1: standalone RMSE (all / matched / unmatched) of B, refresh and refresh_mask, and lm25_32 alone, per reading (October, July natural, July thinned, December natural)
readings.L2: blend with v9 as round B: (1 - b) v9 + b X for b in 0.35, 0.5 (v9 = the cross-fitted v9 of the month: October scratch/v24/2025-10.parquet, July / December from runs/clean_line_screens/hour/dev_stack.parquet), against the same with B; paired-day 95% interval of the difference
readings.masking: refresh_mask against refresh on unmatched rows (seed-matched): what masking adds, per reading

protocol.GO: An item is GO when its L2 blend at b = 0.35 is at least 0.3% below B's on October's LIRF non-population rows with the paired-day interval below zero, AND at least 0.3% below B's on the a13-thinned July LIRF non-population rows (the July 2026 regime) with the interval below zero, AND not worse than B on natural July and December. If both items are GO, refresh_mask is carried only if it also beats refresh on thinned July's unmatched rows; otherwise refresh.
protocol.after: A GO item goes to a separately declared development round on the clean line's footing (LIRF network seeds on the leave-one-month-out January and July folds, the forward fold, the January-November refit and the twelve-month refit; GPU only if turnaround then matters, said before launch), read inside the shipped stack's LIRF blends and gate (v45). No GO: closed on evidence. Every upload is the user's decision; nothing is derived from official scores.

features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)

amendments.before: any prediction or score of the declared lref32 / lm25_32 runs (all eight were still training)
amendments.change: The baseline B of every reading is the four round-B design seeds of ctx_lirf (runs/adsb_ctx/lirf_design/ctx_lirf_s1..s4/design, the same fit partition and October monitor), predicted on the same inputs as the new runs by tools/ctx3_lirf_predict.py --baseline (October scorer check against their stop predictions; July natural / thinned, December natural / thinned). The declaration named no fold-matched December baseline (the v29 check read December from the refit fold), and a 16-seed July baseline against four new seeds mixes seed count into the comparison. The 16-seed ens_ctx_lirf July reading (runs/adsb_ctx/regime_check_lirf/2025-07.parquet) stays in the report as a reference, not in the rule.
amendments.rule: GO unchanged otherwise: L2 at b = 0.35 at least 0.3% below B on October and on a13-thinned July (intervals below zero), not worse than B on natural July and natural December.
